title: Elon Musk Asks if Ambani Is India’s Real Boss
description: Why Elon Musk questioned Mukesh Ambani’s influence over Starlink in India, what Rahul Gandhi said, and how the Indian government answered the claims.
faq: Did Elon Musk actually ask if Ambani is the real boss of India?
Yes. News reports covering Musk’s October 8, 2026 X post quote him asking that rhetorical question while criticizing delays to Starlink’s commercial launch.
Did the Indian government say Ambani controls Starlink approvals?
No. India’s Ministry of Communications said its satellite communications framework is fair and non-discriminatory and that three licensed operators face security assessments.
What did Rahul Gandhi say to Elon Musk?
Gandhi replied to Musk’s post with a remark inviting him to discover another powerful figure. The exchange drew political reactions but did not determine Starlink’s regulatory status.
Is Starlink already operating commercially in India?
As of the October 13 reporting cited here, Starlink had not started its commercial service. Licensing alone does not complete security assessment and spectrum assignment.

title: Why Elon Musk Called Ambani “Prime Minister”
description: Elon Musk’s “Prime Minister Ambani” remark explained: what he posted, how the Starlink dispute grew, India’s official response, and what happens next.
faq: Did Elon Musk say Mukesh Ambani is the prime minister of India?
Musk sarcastically addressed Ambani as “Prime Minister Ambani” in an October 9, 2026 post criticizing Starlink’s stalled India launch. He did not announce an actual change of government.
Who is the prime minister of India in October 2026?
Narendra Modi is the prime minister; Musk’s reference to Ambani was a rhetorical jab about perceived business influence.
Why has Starlink not launched commercially in India?
India says satellite operators must finish mandatory security assessments and then complete spectrum assignment. The government rejects claims that its process is discriminatory.
What did the Swadeshi Jagran Manch say about Starlink?
On October 13 it urged the government to block Starlink over national-security concerns. That appeal was not itself a government ban or licensing decision.
